display.purpose: Hero headlines, dashboard greetings, high-impact numbers. Used once per view.

headline.purpose: Primary section headers. The workhorse heading.

title.purpose: Card titles, drawer headings. Clear but not shouting.

body.purpose: Primary reading text. Comfortable at 0.875rem for daily use.

label.purpose: Form labels, metadata, chips. ALL CAPS with 0.05em tracking. Functional, not decorative.

motion.name: spring-tab
motion.purpose: Bottom nav active tab indicator animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action button. Violet background, white text, full pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6C63FF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #675DF9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default action button. Transparent with input border. Used for most interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #1B1B24; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #C7C4D8; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(199, 196, 216, 0.3); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Tinted red background. For delete and dangerous actions. Never a solid red block.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: rgba(212, 66, 61, 0.1); color: #D4423D; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(212, 66, 61, 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(212, 66, 61, 0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface with 1px border. The primary container for content. Border shifts to primary on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C7C4D8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #6C63FF; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1B1B24; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #464555; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Full pill input with tinted background. Focus state adds primary border and ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(199, 196, 216, 0.3); color: #1B1B24; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #C7C4D8; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #777587; } .ds-input:focus { border: 2px solid #6C63FF; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.4); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Full pill badge. Primary for active states, outline for metadata.
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { background: #6C63FF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-badge-outline { background: rgba(199, 196, 216, 0.3); color: #1B1B24; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #C7C4D8; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Fixed bottom nav with rounded top corners. Active tab gets primary color with spring animation.
components.html: HomeStudents
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; padding: 12px 16px 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; z-index: 50; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: #777587; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: color 0.15s ease-out; padding: 4px 16px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #6C63FF; background: rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.06); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #6C63FF; }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circle avatar with accent background and initials fallback.
components.css: .ds-avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F6F2FF; color: #1B1B24; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview: TutorPal is a tutoring management tool for private tutors who juggle students, classes, and schedules. The design system embraces Modern Functionalism — a high-contrast, mathematically precise aesthetic stripped of visual noise. No gradients, no transparency, no decorative depth. Sophistication comes from masterful control of white space, bold Manrope typography, and a Border-First architectural logic. This system explicitly rejects the corporate spreadsheet look and the SaaS-cream AI default. TutorPal feels like a well-organized desk — warm, precise, calm — not accounting software or a generic dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Border-first architecture: solid 1px outlines create hierarchy, not shadows or gradients
Surface color shifts for depth: layering solid blocks of color, not elevation
Bold Manrope typography: high-contrast headlines, scannable body text
Warm violet identity: #6C63FF as the singular accent, used with restraint
Clean & restrained components: content does the talking, surfaces stay quiet

rules.name: The Solid Boundary Rule
rules.body: No gradients, no transparency (except disabled states), no standard box-shadows. Depth is communicated through surface color layering and solid 1px borders. The system is unapologetically flat.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary violet is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity creates hierarchy. When in doubt, use a neutral surface shift instead of adding more purple.

rules.name: The Label Restraint Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label style is used for functional metadata (form labels, chip text, nav labels), not as a decorative kicker above every section heading. One label per context, not a uniform scaffold.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Standard box-shadow is prohibited. If an element needs to feel elevated, make it lighter (shift toward white) or add a 2px border in the primary color for active states. Depth through color, not lighting effects.

dos: Do use solid 1px borders for all card and input outlines. The border IS the design.
Do use surface color shifts (page → section → card → float) for depth hierarchy.
Do use the primary violet sparingly — one accent per view, rare enough to create hierarchy.
Do use Manrope weight contrast (400/600/700/800) for typographic hierarchy instead of size alone.
Do use full pill shapes for buttons, badges, and inputs. Confident and approachable.
Do use ALL CAPS labels (0.05em tracking) for functional metadata only — form labels, chip text, nav labels.
Do use tertiary (#914800) for urgent notifications — sophisticated warmth vs harsh red.
Do use 16px border-radius on cards and modals. Gentle curve, never boxy.
donts: Don't use gradients of any kind — even subtle ones. The system is unapologetically flat.
Don't use standard box-shadow for elevation. Use surface color shifts instead.
Don't use pure black (#000000) for text — always use on-surface (#1B1B24).
Don't use transparency (alpha < 100%) except for disabled states and tinted backgrounds.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe. Never intentional.
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop-blur, or decorative transparency. Purposeful only.
Don't use corporate spreadsheet layouts — dense data tables, monochrome grids, overwhelming numbers.
Don't use the SaaS-cream AI default — warm beige backgrounds, soft shadows, gradient accents.
Don't put uppercase label kicker text above every section heading. One label per context, not a uniform scaffold.
Don't use 32px+ border-radius on cards. Cards top out at 16px; full pill is for buttons and badges.
Don't pair 1px border + box-shadow with blur ≥ 16px on the same element. Pick one, never both.
